TextView.android:text: Basmati rice in vegetative tillering shows an acute physiological demand for nitrogen. Telemetry captured 90 mg/kg, indicating active uptake. Neem oil coating reduces nitrogen volatilization and denitrification, providing a sustained nutrient release over 18 days while mitigating leaching losses by 22%.
DAP 50 kg/Ac + MOP 20 kg/Ac at field puddling & transplanting.
Neem-Coated Urea 45 kg/Ac + Zinc Booster (21% ZnSO4, 5 kg/Ac)
💧 Broadcast right before secondary shallow flush irrigation.
Final Urea top-dressing 25 kg/Ac for spikelet fertility and grain filling.

Avoid broad-surface broadcasting during peak midday heat (>32°C) to prevent ammonia burn and atmospheric vaporization. Execute top dressing in early morning (06:00 - 09:00) or late afternoon prior to water regulation.
